description: Detach an agent (by name, or id with `byId`) from the installed plugin without confirmation, removing its generated files; the server deletes the row itself once no plugin links it any more (one another plugin still links is kept). Then regenerates the installed plugin locally, like `athenode init` without confirmation (the result adds `install` and `regeneration`, whose `pluginChanges` lists the tools whose plugin package or declaration was rewritten, with `suppressedIn` naming another tool's local settings file the plugin was switched off in; `missingEnvVars` is checked against the MCP server's environment, not your shell). If regeneration fails, the backend change is still saved and the tool returns an error. Requires an installed plugin (`npx @athenode/cli init`), unless `pluginId` names another plugin of the project: that one is changed on the server only, with no local regeneration.

byId.description: `identifier` is a backend id, not a name (CLI: --by-id).

identifier.description: Agent name, or its backend id with byId.

pluginId.description: Id of the plugin to act on (see plugins_list); the installed plugin if omitted (CLI: --plugin-id).

name: agents_remove
title: Remove agent
